cases.query: What failure mode does standard 3D Gaussian Splatting exhibit with too few input views?
cases.anchor: resulting in structural inaccuracies and visual artifacts.

cases.query: Which two unresolved problems with earlier prior-based sparse-view methods motivate PViGS?
cases.anchor: The traditional monocular depth prior suffers from the inherent ambiguity

cases.query: How are Plane Sweep Volumes constructed from a reference and source image?
cases.anchor: comparing them to calculate reprojection error maps as weights.

cases.query: How does the added Gaussian visibility weight combine the two view directions?
cases.anchor: an external learnable visibility weight parameter, which is leveraged to fuse two directions of both reference and source views.

cases.query: How many candidate warped images are generated per training view during augmentation?
cases.anchor: generate N candidate warped images (N=360).

cases.query: What IQA threshold and filtering-rate range are used for the four NVS datasets?
cases.anchor: we set 𝜅= 0 .6 and the corresponding filtering ratios range between 40% and 50%.

cases.query: Why does the method recursively aggregate visibility along a ray?
cases.anchor: helps suppress depth ambiguity caused by sparse views.

cases.query: Which two rendered attributes are constrained against the visibility prior for stable sparse-view training?
cases.anchor: output both visibility 𝑉 ′(𝑝) and accumulated transmittance 𝑡𝑖.

cases.query: Which pretrained model supplies features for PSV-wise semantic regularization?
cases.anchor: a pre-trained DINO-ViT model is used to impose spatial semantic consistency

cases.query: On which four benchmark datasets is PViGS evaluated?
cases.anchor: the LLFF [38], the DTU [39], T&T(Tanks and Temples) [41], and the Mip- NeRF360 [40].

cases.query: How many PSV depth planes are used for LLFF, T&T, Mip-NeRF360, and DTU?
cases.anchor: 𝑘= 64 for LLFF, T&T, and Mip-NeRF360, and 𝑘= 128 for DTU.

cases.query: How is the LLFF test split selected and how are its remaining training views chosen?
cases.anchor: Every eighth image in the sequence is systematically chosen for the test set. Subsequently, the training views are constructed by evenly sampling from the remaining images.

cases.query: What throughput, training time, memory, and image-quality scores are listed for PViGS on LLFF?
How do the authors justify the method's extra training computation?
cases.anchor: the additional computational cost reflects a necessary quality-first trade-off

cases.query: What PSNR values does PViGS achieve under the two three-view LLFF resolution settings?
cases.anchor: achieving the highest PSNR scores of 21.27 dB and 20.66 dB under 3-view input settings.

cases.query: What PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS does PViGS obtain on Tanks and Temples with three views?
What three reconstruction metrics are reported for PViGS on DTU with three views?
What property of the camera inputs limits the reliability of PViGS visibility priors?
cases.anchor: The effectiveness of visibility priors depends on the overlapping area between input views.

cases.query: When does visibility-guided regularization provide its largest relative benefit?
cases.anchor: the efficacy of the visibility-based regularization becomes more evident for sparse views.

cases.query: What future distillation approach is proposed to reduce dependence on pixel-level depth priors?
cases.anchor: incorporating Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) into the Gaussian radiance fields.
